title: My Friend and My Sister
text:
Ali is my friend. He is very kind. He helps me with my homework. He is also funny and makes me laugh.

My sister Ayse is different. She is shy, so she does not talk much in class. But she is very smart. She reads many books every week.

questions.text: What does Ali do to help?
Why does Ayse not talk much in class?
How does the writer probably feel about Ali?
options: Happy to have him as a friend

questions.text: What kind of person is Ayse probably?

vocabulary.definition: friendly and helpful to other people
nervous and quiet around other people
able to learn and think quickly

paragraph_translations: Ali benim arkadaşım. Çok nazik. Ev ödevimde bana yardım eder. Ayrıca komik ve beni güldürür.
Kız kardeşim Ayşe farklı. Utangaç, bu yüzden derste çok konuşmaz. Ama çok zeki. Her hafta çok kitap okur.
